subject: Wave C part 1: S07 search, S08 qbank (S10 cards after S06 + S12a)
body:
# Wave C (part 1 starts now)

| Task | Agent | Owns | Depends on | Brief |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| S07 Local search + Search screen | seg07-search | apps/api/naadi_api/embeddings/**, apps/api/naadi_api/search_routes*, apps/web/src/search/** | S02, S04 (in review), S05, S06 | docs/segments/07-search.md |
| S08 Qbank builder + tutor mode | seg08-qbank | apps/api/naadi_api/qbank/**, apps/web/src/practice/** | S02, S03, S05, S06 | docs/segments/08-qbank-tutor.md |
| S10 Cards (FSRS) | (starts after S06 + S12a rework land) | apps/api/naadi_api/cards/**, apps/web/src/cards/** | S06, S12a | docs/segments/10-cards-fsrs.md |

Binding notes: answer/explanation fields never reach a client before an attempt (S08 owns the proof; S07 indexes question stem+options only). Service-role code must apply RLS-equivalent visibility (attempt-gated question-linked flashcards; own-only notes). New tables: RLS in the same migration + coverage test + live_check list. Use segment 01's frozen-copy axe helper. Local e2e: your own ports, reuseExistingServer:false. Temp files inside your worktree.
